_why: velo-cli validate resolves a SQL file's config_file property against the PROCESS CWD rather than the directory of the SQL file that declares it, so 12 of 13 shipped .sql files fail from the repo root and pass from their own directory. The plumbing to fix it ALREADY EXISTS and is used elsewhere: QueryAnalyzer::with_base_dir (query_analyzer.rs:282) and load_config_file_to_properties_with_base (config_loader.rs:46), and velo-sql.rs:719/:1592 already call SqlValidator::with_base_dir(&parent_dir). The gap is ConfigValidator (validation/config_validator.rs:32 and :41), which constructs QueryAnalyzer::new() with no base dir at all — so the analyzer falls back to cwd-relative resolution.

anchors._note: the two construction sites with NO base dir — this is the defect. Both must take the SQL file's directory.

grammar_reference._note: A Kafka sink needs all three of '<name>.type', '<name>.bootstrap.servers', '<name>.topic'. The config_file property points at a YAML whose path is relative to the SQL file, e.g. '../configs/market_data_source.yaml'. Do not invent syntax.
